# Andreas Janson

> Dr. Andreas Janson is a research group lead at the Institute of Information Systems and Digital Business (IWI-HSG), University of St.Gallen, Switzerland. He studies how digital services are understood and designed: privacy by design, trust in AI, digital sovereignty, conversational AI, digital learning, gamification and digital nudging, mostly with design science research.

ORCID: 0000-0003-3149-0340 · Contact: see https://a-janson.github.io/ (e-mail on the home page)

## Pages

- [Home](https://a-janson.github.io/): Dr. Andreas Janson, research group lead at IWI-HSG, University of St.Gallen. Research on privacy by design, trust in AI, digital sovereignty, conversational AI, digital learning and design science.
- [Publications](https://a-janson.github.io/publications.html): All publications of Andreas Janson (University of St.Gallen) in ISR, JAIS, EJIS, ISJ, JIT, AMLE and at ICIS, ECIS, HICSS, WI: searchable, filterable, with BibTeX export.
- [Projects](https://a-janson.github.io/projects.html): Research projects and grants of Andreas Janson: Innosuisse flagship SCESC (HSG Impact Award 2026), SNSF, DFG and BMBF projects on AI, privacy, nudging and digital learning.
- [Teaching](https://a-janson.github.io/teaching.html): Teaching of Andreas Janson at St.Gallen, Hamburg and Kassel: flipped classroom, courses, AOM management education workshops and supervised theses.
- [Awards](https://a-janson.github.io/awards.html): Awards of Andreas Janson: AIS Best Conference Paper on Education 2024, DESRIST and HICSS best papers, ICIS best theory paper runner-up, HSG Impact Award 2026.
- [Service](https://a-janson.github.io/service.html): Academic service of Andreas Janson: track chair at ICIS, ECIS, WI and DESRIST, associate editor, AIS Associate Vice President Education Curations, reviewing.
